qualification_boundary.task_switch_reference: KVM emulates VMX task-switch exits. The 28 original-byte task comparisons per SDK/core are independent software reference evidence, not physical task-switch or task-debug qualification.
qualification_boundary.task_profile: Ordered ordinary RAM with declared publication/access ordering; no universal microcode order, TLB model, contiguous-physical TSS model or competing-fault claim.
qualification_boundary.vm86: Incoming task state stops at ModeUnavailable with retained continuation; destination execution is not implemented.
remaining: Full real/protected/VM86/IA-32e mode transitions and full-width machine state
Software SMM save-area/return and SGX EPCM/SSA/AEX ownership
Unbound asynchronous producers and remaining original-machine state banks
Physical AMX/MPX/HLE/RTM/FRED/UINTR/SNP and unowned xstate qualification
